company_notes:
Account summary: Skybound builds a mid-market KM/search product for customer success teams. Primary goal: improve result relevance with a reranking endpoint integrated into their existing BM25+vector pipeline. Started on Hosted API to validate model choices and relevance gains; moving toward Dedicated to stabilize p95 latency and enable VPC for customer data residency.

POC details / technical notes: ran offline rerank pipeline where upstream candidate generator (BM25 + sparse vectors) returns top-100, then call Redwood rerank endpoint to score and sort. Eval set = 10k labeled queries (mix of support tickets and product docs). Offline metrics: baseline NDCG@10 = 0.42, rerank model A (open-llm variant) NDCG@10 = 0.63 (delta +0.21). MRR improved from 0.31 -> 0.52 on the eval set. Offline throughput: batch offline scoring (10k queries x 100 candidates) completed in ~3.5 hours on Hosted API; individual synchronous rerank calls during live testing showed p50 ~85ms, p95 ~260ms when scoring 50-75 candidates (no streaming), variance spiked during peak loads.

Business / commercial: Product team likes Hosted API for speed of iteration. They want predictable performance and data isolation for certain enterprise customers—talking Dedicated as next step. Price sensitivity: mid-market procurement wants committed ARR around $100k/year to justify Dedicated. Finance requested a clearer committed throughput/slots to map to expected cost.

Security / compliance: must support SSO (SAML), audit logging for inference, and data residency (EAST-US control plane preference). Legal asked for SOC2 Type II report and an explicit data deletion SLA for POC data.

Quotes / paraphrases: "Big win if we can reduce time-to-signal for support reps — higher first-contact resolution." — Head of Product. "We're seeing great NDCG gains offline, but worried about p95 variability when we spike candidate counts." — Eng lead.

Operational asks from SE team: recommend candidate count knobs, caching/prefix strategies, and quantization model suggestion to reduce per-token costs for rerank scoring. Also requested example rollout playbook for switching from Hosted -> Dedicated with canary traffic split.
